[{"id":"Samplesheet test","description":"Test to create a sample-sheet for VIP analysis. ","sql":"SELECT 
    ind.id AS individual_id,
    'ERDERA' AS project_id,
    pm.pedigree as family_id,
    MAX(
    CASE
        WHEN pm2.relation = 'Biological Father' THEN pm2.individual
    END) AS paternal_id,
    MAX(
    CASE
        WHEN pm2.relation = 'Biological Mother' THEN pm2.individual
    END) AS maternal_id,
    CASE
        WHEN ind."gender at birth" = 'assigned male at birth' THEN 'male'
        WHEN ind."gender at birth" = 'assigned female at birth' THEN 'female'
    END AS sex,
    pm.affected AS affected,
    CASE
        WHEN pm.relation = 'Patient' THEN true
        ELSE false
    END AS proband,
    array_agg(DISTINCT cop.code) AS hpo_ids,
    MAX(
    CASE
        WHEN exp."library strategy" = 'Whole Genome Sequencing' THEN 'WGS'
        WHEN exp."library strategy" = 'Whole Exome Sequencing' THEN 'WES'
    END) AS sequencing_method,
    array_agg(DISTINCT f.id) AS gvcf

FROM "Individuals" ind

-- Join pedigree members
LEFT JOIN "Pedigree members" pm
    ON pm.individual = ind.id

LEFT JOIN "Pedigree members" pm2
    ON pm2.relative = ind.id

-- Join Processes via unnest
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT *
    FROM "Processes" p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(p.individuals) AS process_individual
    WHERE process_individual = ind.id
) p ON true

-- Join Phenotype observations
LEFT JOIN "Phenotype observations" po
    ON po."part of clinical observation" = p.id

LEFT JOIN "CatalogueOntologies"."Phenotypes" cop
    ON po.type = cop.name
    AND (po.excluded = false OR po.excluded IS NULL)

LEFT JOIN "Experiments" e
    ON e.id = p.id

-- Join srDNA to get sequencing method 
LEFT JOIN "Experiments srDNA" exp
    ON exp.id = p.id

-- Join Materials via unnest
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT *
    FROM "Materials" m
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(m.individuals) AS material_individual
    WHERE material_individual = ind.id
) m ON true

-- Join Files corresponding to that Material
LEFT JOIN "Files" f
    ON f.id = m.id

GROUP BY
    ind.id,
    pm.relation,
    pm.pedigree,
    pm.affected
